claims.statement: For every computable system satisfying sufficient observability, authorized actuation, algorithmically treatable acceptance, and effect/action binding, a QIK-VRT wrapper exists.
QIK-VRT distinguishes execution from accepted effect.
The phrase 'systems under QIK-VRT' is interpreted as universal meta-integration, not domination or unauthorized control.
QIK-VRT is empirically faster than all alternative integration architectures.
Universal integrability implies universal enforceability or bypass of access controls.
claims.reason: Authorization is an explicit theorem premise.

claims.statement: Universal integration implies universal prediction of arbitrary programs.

claims.reason: No bridge from functional architecture to phenomenal experience is proved.
